::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 26th 1861  
**From:** Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Westcountry Studies Library, Exeter/ Yonge 1861/9.
:::

My dear [Miss Smith](people/person_263.qmd),

I send you an [order](organizations/other_102.qmd) for the chapters of [the Thorne](other_books/otherbook_275.qmd) that have appeared- also another to correct. I think people like it much - your neighbour [Miss Wilford](people/person_1520.qmd) was talking about it yesterday she is staying with [her aunt](people/person_384.qmd) at [St Cross](organizations/other_130.qmd), and I am always much tempted to betray you

yours sincerely

C M Yonge

The Order is payable to Ann Smith - more names always cause blunders
